protocol_config.case_design_scope: stratified all-layer/role real-W/A panel by default; --full-cases enables Cartesian stress; optional CLI limits are smoke-only
protocol_config.score_formula: proxy gain=(MSE_STD-MSE_PLAYER)/MSE_STD per case; means are unweighted over actual captured cases
protocol_config.runtime_measurement: sum of elapsed six-API calls; wall_seconds is reported separately and neither is official time
protocol_config.error_source_decomposition: candidate API outputs are reused in evaluator-only Linear W/A and Attention Q/K/V control arms; it does not alter proxy means or API call counts
protocol_config.trend_validation: same-cohort pairwise ordering against user-confirmed anchors; diagnostic-only

trend_diagnostics.note: diagnostic only; official scores are never used to alter proxy means

formula.arms: E00=standard W+standard A; E10=candidate W+standard A; E01=standard W+candidate A; E11=candidate W+candidate A
formula.interaction_gain: (E10+E01-E00-E11)/E00; positive means super-additive complementarity, negative means overlapping/diminishing returns

formula.arms: E000=standard Q/K/V; E100=candidate Q; E010=candidate K; E001=candidate V; E110=candidate Q+K; E111=candidate Q+K+V
